title: Attach positional anchor info to ParsedNode.
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/eemeli/yaml/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I affirm that I am submitting my own writing, and not the output of an LLM or similar tool.

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

I created [`mdx-content-mapper`](https://github.com/remcohaszing/mdx-content-mapper). This adds [MDX](https://mdxjs.com) support to TypeScript 7.1 and greater. As a part of this, I added [frontmatter](https://mdxjs.com/guides/frontmatter/) support, so people get type errors, definitions, etc in their YAML frontmatter. A part of this, is mapping YAML anchors and aliases.

These mappings require positional information. However, only anchors are attached as a string to a node. The anchor position is list in the CTS to AST transformation.

### Describe the solution you'd like.

I would like the anchor position to be preserved in the AST. I can think of two solutions:

1. `ParsedNode` gets a new optional property `anchorRange`. This is the range of the anchor. This solution is backwards compatible.
2. `ParsedNode.anchor` is changed from a `string` to a new dedicated `Anchor` class, just like scalars, aliases, etc. This is a breaking change.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

```js
if (node.anchor) {
  const anchor = `&${node.anchor}`
  const start = yamlText.lastIndexOf(anchor, node.range[0])
  const end = start + anchor.length
}
```

### Additional context

The alternative works, but I think the approach could be slightly better.
